position_rules: Positions1-18: scrambled paper-certificate mnemonic. Positions19-27: nine-word input to certificate-password KDF. All use English dictionary; concatenation is not a BIP39 mnemonic.

external_secret.guidance: Any supported mnemonic passphrase stays outside Tessaveil; wallet login/spending passwords are distinct. Paper27 already includes its nine password words; no extra secret is inferred.

semantic_distinction: Historical27 =18+9 certificate for a Byron 12 wallet. Never concatenate into Icarus, generic BIP39 or modern Lace PGP paper mode. Offline vector only verifies dictionary/partition/password; full rust-cardano-crypto unscrambling remains unverified.
